evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Declarative statement of a decision supplies the fact of the switch itself as the controlling information.
Evidence-and-benefit argument for the decision: quantitative gain plus cost reduction as offered benefits.
Summary heading restates the decision as established fact, controlling the informational frame of the record.
Structured restatement of the quantitative performance argument as a recorded justification point.
Fixing a deadline in the record imposes a time-bound expectation on the migration.
